decision.reopen_trigger: After the minutes publish, an independently verifiable fact change plus a public attributable non-directional calculation question or replacement numeric example tied to that fact. Any qualified work must refresh the existing FOMC article rather than create another generic event-risk shape.
decision.rationale: At the scan timestamp the minutes had not published. Source-checked public material remains calendar or directional discussion. One clock delta is not sufficient to recreate an existing fixed-risk explanation or invent a traffic playbook.
